# `⊖` — Reverse first / Rotate first

Function. Keys: `Alt-o Minus`. Hanzi: `纵` (`縱`). Ranks: `∞` monadic, `∞ ∞` dyadic

First-axis forms of [`⌽`](circle-stile.qmd). `⊖⍠K` overrides the axis.

```bpl
⊖2 3ρι6ₓ            ⍝ [3 4 5◇0 1 2]ₓ
1⊖3 2ρι6ₓ           ⍝ [2 3◇4 5◇0 1]ₓ
```

## Inverse

`⊖⁻Y` is `⊖Y`. `X⊖⁻Y` rotates `Y` back by `X`.

```bpl
1⊖⁻[3 4◇1 2]   ⍝ [1 2◇3 4]
```
